title: the lane nobody *measured* is holding
dek: Twelve channels, fifty receipted outlier rows, eight positioning dimensions. Where the supplement-and-performance growth niche is crowded, where it is contested, and the one belief slot standing empty. Every score cites specimens; every open lane carries a demand caveat and a decision-ready move.

sections.heading: the verdict
sections.body: Every channel in the measured pool sells a mechanism: new tools (Chappell, 21.8x outlier), persuasion mastery (Sabri Suby, 14.1x), platform arbitrage (MyWifeQuitHerJob, 64.2x), launch-is-easy white-labeling (Supliful, 33.2x), measurement discipline (Marketing Operators). Zero of fifty ranked rows touch claim substantiation, compliance strategy, or the message decision for regulated categories. The recommended lane is an intersection, not a single attribute: operating supplement/performance founders (nobody's named audience) x claim-science topics (zero rows) x buyer-side embodied proof (nobody's register) x calm-practitioner delivery (absent from winners). One honest caveat travels with it: zero rows also means zero demand evidence, so the first three batches are the probe.

sections.heading: what the receipts show
sections.tag: SPECIMEN FLOOR: EVERY SCORE CITES ITS ROWS

rows.claim: The supplement-specific attention leader teaches launch mechanics, never claim defensibility - and its launch-is-easy belief manufactures the sea of sameness
rows.evidence: Supliful's top outliers: 'No Warehouse, No Problem' (20K views, 33.2x channel normal, 2025-01-24); 'Launch Your Product Line and Sell Immediately' (11K, 18.3x, 2025-01-17)

rows.claim: Mechanism-of-the-week content is the niche's strongest current wave
rows.evidence: 'Claude Has Officially Changed Facebook Ads Forever' - 41K views, 21.8x, 2026-08-09; transcript opens: 'Meta just officially upgraded its Ads MCP and the changes are absolutely mind-blowing'

rows.claim: Depth exists in the pool, but it is claim-agnostic persuasion, not claim science
rows.evidence: Sabri Suby's '27 Minutes' masterclass (201K, 14.1x, 2026-07-31) teaches attention-and-conversion psychology from 1960s DR ads; nothing on what a regulated brand may assert or prove

rows.claim: The buyer's own watering hole already distrusts ROAS - the ground for the Data Mirage thesis is pre-tilled
rows.evidence: 'Haus CMO Reveals the Incrementality Index Behind Smarter ROAS Calls' (4.8K, 3.6x, 2026-08-15) on Marketing Operators, the DTC operator roundtable

rows.claim: Proof currency in the pool is seller-side scale, which Farrice should not fight
rows.evidence: Quad Lock half-billion exit interview (39K, 15.9x, 2026-07-30); 'I Spent 1 Week with Billionaires' (760K, 6.4x). Nobody runs buyer-side embodied proof

rows.claim: The nearest lane neighbor has zero breakout rows - steady baseline, no outliers
rows.evidence: Chew On This (30.2K subs, supplement DTC operators podcast) contributes no rows to the ranked-50; absence means no breakouts vs their own baseline, not no audience

sections.heading: four whitespace entries, four *moves*
sections.dek: Unclaimed on measured data, with the demand caveat stated.

items.action: W1 - The Defensible Claim lane: claim it with three named topics in batch 1
items.why: Zero of 50 ranked rows touch claims/compliance; topics ready: the $53,088 sentence, the nine-homepages teardown, honest-claim-vs-lie

items.action: W2 - Name the operating supplement founder in line one
items.why: Supliful aims below the ICP (aspirants), MO/CTC aim across all DTC; the named audience is empty; open wide, land narrow per Wide-Deep-Bridge-Home

items.action: W3 - The Fix Aisle: a recurring mechanism-teardown segment
items.why: All 12 channels install adopt-the-mechanism beliefs; the weekly trending fix (e.g. the 21.8x Meta-MCP wave) writes the prompt; grant what it does, name the decision it cannot make

items.action: W4 - Run the conversion story as the proof asset
items.why: 2018 hype-seller to 2026 claim-safe strategist, documented eight years apart; incumbents cannot copy a history they do not have

sections.heading: hypothesis verdicts
sections.body:
The dossier's seven self-assessed edges, adjudicated against the grid: substance depth confirmed (scoped to claim science, where the pool is empty); unique proof contested and redirected (scale-proof incumbents own that register - move to buyer-side proof); avatar specificity confirmed; topic selection confirmed as opportunity with demand unproven; delivery style confirmed as open; storytelling format and visual format confirmed as gaps to close by borrowing the niche's measured skeletons under the two-zone rule.

Blunt call, kept blunt: do not compete with Hormozi, Sabri, or Fogarty for general founder-marketing attention. Their wedges are the fence, not the prize.

sections.heading: what this map cannot *see*
sections.body: Coverage: YouTube measured; TikTok and Instagram none; LinkedIn (where the sales motion lives) outside the radar. Emptiness verdicts are outlier-pool verdicts, not catalog-wide - a per-channel catalog check is a named gap. Attention rivals are not service rivals: KeyGrow, Pennock, Toni Bubb have no measured YouTube presence, so service-market saturation is out of scope here. Velocity fields are unreadable at this snapshot interval (two pulls, 64 minutes apart). The pack sees views, never conversions; the bullseye overlay owns the money judgment.
